messages:
Maya Singh: Hi all — opened a small docs PR to add HSM key-rotation steps and air-gapped curl examples for Private/VPC installs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3821 :memo:
Eduardo Ramos: Thanks Maya, skimmed. Looks good overall but the KMS section still references the old key-policy link that 404s.
Jin Park: Which link? I can push a quick fix.
Maya Singh: In the HSM section under 'Rotate keys', there's a link to /cryptography/key-policies that should be /private/kms/key-policies (I think). Also the airgap curl example used a public endpoint — needs to show how to use the local cert bundle.
Priya Patel: For air-gapped installs we should prefer the 'internal CA bundle' instructions we published last quarter. Suggest adding a short snippet that shows `curl --cacert /etc/redwood/ca.pem` and `--resolve` for the internal hostname.
Maya Singh: Good call. I'm going to add a shell example.
Maya Singh: ```bash
# rotate key via HSM management appliance (air-gapped)
export HSM_HOST=10.10.5.2
export HSM_PORT=8443
curl --cacert /etc/redwood/ca.pem \
  --resolve "hsm.internal:${HSM_PORT}:${HSM_HOST}" \
  -X POST https://hsm.internal:${HSM_PORT}/api/v1/keys/rotate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $HSM_ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key_id":"redwood-main-1","rotation_mode":"in-place"}'
```
Sam (infra): @Maya can you also add a short troubleshooting note about firewall rules — common issue is blocking the HSM management port from the installer VM. Recommend adding the iptables/nft example.
Maya Singh: Adding that too. Also adding a python SDK snippet for customers who want to call the KMS through our SDK inside a private network.
Maya Singh: ```python
# example: fetch wrapping key from local KMS gateway
from redwood_sdk import PrivateKMSClient
client = PrivateKMSClient(base_url="https://kms.internal:443", ca_path="/etc/redwood/ca.pem")
wrapped = client.get_wrapping_key("redwood-main-1")
# unwrap locally with HSM-backed key material (pseudo)
print(wrapped.key_id)
```
Priya Patel: That SDK snippet is helpful. Can you include a brief line about environment variables (REDWOOD_KMS_URL, REDWOOD_CA_PATH) for CLI users?
Maya Singh: Will add env example.
Eduardo Ramos: One more: the network diagram PNG referenced in the doc is currently named `vpc-airgap-networking.png` in the repo, but the markdown points to `vpc-airgap-network-diagram.png`. Small path/name mismatch.
Jin Park: I'll push a commit to the PR to fix that image name and the broken key-policy link.
Maya Singh: Thanks Jin. Quick note for reviewers: this PR touches the Private install guide and the KMS/HSM troubleshooting appendix. I tried to keep the changes minimal and annotated them in the PR diff.
docs-bot: CI: lint checks passed for PR #3821 — 3 files changed, 1 image added.
Sam (infra): Reviewed the networking text and firewall examples. Left one nit about mentioning UDP ephemeral ports for some HSMs (depends on vendor). Not blocking.
Priya Patel: LGTM from docs side once the link and image name are fixed.
Eduardo Ramos: LGTM for security content (checked phrasing around key rotation and never exposing plaintext key material).
Jin Park: Fixed the two links and image name, pushed a small commit (updated PR).
Maya Singh: Awesome — thanks everyone. Merging after docs-bot confirms updated CI. Should I also backport a small note to the on-prem migration checklist?
Sam (infra): Yes please, add a one-line callout in the migration checklist about performing a test rotation in preprod before cutover.
Maya Singh: Will do. Merged once CI green. :tada:
